tagline: One tap to share family moments
hero_title:
Check on your parents
with just one tap
hero_subtitle:
No more complex messaging apps. Seniors can send updates in 3 seconds.
Stay connected with your parents' daily well-being.
problem_title: Millions of families face this daily
problem_1_desc: Constantly worried about parents, but calling every time feels intrusive.
problem_2_desc: Traditional messengers are too complicated for seniors - too many buttons, small text.
problem_3_desc: When they read but don't reply, worry only increases.
solution_subtitle: Parents tap a button. Children see updates in real-time.
feature_1_desc: Buttons twice the size of a fingertip. Easy for seniors to tap.
feature_2_desc: Push to talk, release to send. Free voice calls over internet.
feature_3_desc: See your parent's daily check-ins at a glance.
feature_4_desc: Get notified when unusual patterns are detected.
feature_5_desc: All siblings can monitor parents together.
feature_6_desc: English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese support. Perfect for overseas families.
testimonial_1: My father struggled with smartphones, but he started using this app right away. Getting the 'I've eaten' notification every day gives me such peace of mind.
testimonial_2: Living overseas, I was always worried about my parents. Now I can check on them in real-time.
testimonial_3: The walkie-talkie feature is amazing. My mom can hear the grandkids instantly whenever she wants.
cta_subtitle: Launching first half of 2026. Be the first to know.
form_agree: I agree to the collection and use of personal information
success_message: We'll notify you as soon as we launch.
faq_1_q: Is it okay if my parents aren't good with smartphones?
faq_1_a: Absolutely! The Anbu parent app only has 4 big buttons. Just turn on the screen and tap the button you want. Large text and high contrast colors make it easy for seniors.
faq_2_a: WiFi or mobile data connection is required. However, it uses very little data, so basic plans are sufficient.
faq_3_q: Is the parent app really free?
faq_3_a: Yes, the parent app is free forever with no ads. Only premium features in the child app are paid, and basic features are free even in the child app.
faq_4_q: What if there are multiple siblings?
faq_4_a: With family groups, all siblings can check on parents together. Premium supports 5 members, Premium+ supports unlimited.
faq_5_a: Yes! It works anywhere with internet connection. We support Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese (Simplified/Traditional).
